$comment: Source clips for the website demos, encoded by scripts/encode-demos.mjs. Paths are relative to demos/ (git-ignored originals). 'file.pptx#ppt/media/x.mp4' extracts a video embedded in a slide deck. mode 'loop' = short, silent, autoplaying clip; 'player' = full video with controls. speed > 1 time-lapses silent screen recordings. Metadata shown on the site lives in src/data/demos.yaml.
